banquet_sets_guests_chk.name: banquet_sets_guests_chk
banquet_sets_guests_chk.value: "banquet_sets"."min_guests" is null or "banquet_sets"."max_guests" is null or "banquet_sets"."max_guests" >= "banquet_sets"."min_guests"

promotions_window_chk.name: promotions_window_chk
promotions_window_chk.value: ("promotions"."start_min" is null and "promotions"."end_min" is null) or ("promotions"."start_min" >= 0 and "promotions"."end_min" <= 1440 and "promotions"."end_min" > "promotions"."start_min")
